messages.subject: Copyright label in Rmd files
parts:
Hi all,

I am creating beamer slides using Rmarkdown. 
Before I used to work with R Sweave and I could place over the slides some copyright label using :

\AddEverypageHook{%
  \begin{textblock}{4}(4.5,4)
  \begin{tikzpicture}
  \node[draw,opacity=0.2,rotate=40] at (current page.center) {\normalsize
Copyright 2014 DrunkenPhD
  \end{tikzpicture}
  \end{textblock}}
\mode<presentation> {
\usetheme{Berkeley}
\setbeamertemplate{footline} 
}

Is it possible to make the same in Rmd files?

Please help
